title: More reliable image prompts across languages
summary:
Image prompt translation got a reliability fix, two community projects joined the lists, and speech-to-text docs got more precise.

The image prompt enhancer was updated to reduce rate-limited requests that could leave Chinese and other non-English prompts poorly translated.

LLM7.io joined the LLM Integrations list; it uses Pollinations text generation for an open multimodal platform. Comeback AI joined the project showcase with persona-based replies and generated speech.

Python and JavaScript examples now specify MP3 and WAV, rather than suggesting other audio formats are supported.
